_comment: What scripts/setup-plugins.sh adds and installs. marketplaces: name, GitHub
owner/repo, and whether to turn on Claude Code's background updates for it
(off by default for every marketplace but Anthropic's own). plugins: a
`required` plugin that is not installed and enabled at user scope fails the
run; an `optional` one is only reported. Edit this file to add your own
marketplace or plugins; the script never removes or disables anything.

plugins.why: audit and improve CLAUDE.md files, including this toolkit's template.
visual design guidance for building or reshaping UI.
session history and continuity notes across threads.
current library and framework docs on demand, instead of answering from a stale training cutoff.
upstream process skills (brainstorming, test-driven development, plan writing). Nothing in this toolkit needs it.
read designs from Figma and push designs back. Skip if you never touch design files.
